company.name: TectoAI
company.shortDescription: TectoAI develops artificial intelligence governance software to manage third-party software agents for enterprise organizations.
company.description: TectoAI develops artificial intelligence governance software for enterprise organizations. The company builds a platform to manage third-party software agents within internal workflows and maps specific business roles to identify tasks suitable for technology integration. The platform monitors the daily activities of these artificial intelligence agents during regular operations and detects behavioral drifts and system errors in real time. The application tracks global technology regulations to maintain corporate compliance.
